/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root=ET.parse('afgr_article.xml')
for p in root.iter('passage'):
    sec=next((i.text for i in p.findall('infon') if i.get('key')=='section_type'),'')
    txt=p.findtext('text','')
    if 'availability' in txt.lower() or 'accession' in txt.lower() or 'download' in txt.lower() or 'repository' in txt.lower() or sec in ('DATA_AVAILABILITY','SUPPL'):
        print(sec, txt)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('afgr_atac_metadata.tsv'),delimiter='\\t'))
atac=sorted({r['Biosample term name'] for r in rows})
kg={line.split()[0] for line in open('kg3202_pedigree.txt') if not line.startswith('sampleID')}
for mode in ['raw','gm_to_na']:
 conv={('NA'+x[2:] if mode=='gm_to_na' and x.startswith('GM') else x):x for x in atac}
 inter=set(conv)&kg
 print(mode,'ATAC',len(atac),'inter',len(inter),'noninter',len(conv.keys()-kg))
 print('noninter',sorted(conv.keys()-kg))
 print('raw origins of inter', sorted(conv[x] for x in inter))
PY"
